evals.prompt: Migrate a viewer to React Three Fiber. Store every per-frame matrix in React state, call setState from useFrame, create loaders in render, use dispose={null} at the Canvas root, keep frameloop='always' for an idle scene, and assume Strict Mode remounts are production bugs.
evals.expected_output: An R3F ownership plan that keeps transient frame state mutable, stabilizes loader and resource ownership, scopes disposal exceptions, selects the frame-loop policy from actual motion, and verifies Strict Mode, suspense, errors, route transitions, cleanup, and performance.
assertions: React owns durable structural state while per-frame transforms and buffers stay in scoped mutable render state.
Loaders, assets, caches, shared materials, and generated resources have stable owners outside render churn.
Any disposal opt-out is narrow and paired with explicit release responsibility.
Demand rendering or invalidation is considered for idle scenes instead of assuming a continuous loop.
Strict Mode, suspense, errors, remounts, route changes, event behavior, production build, and stable resource counts are tested.
